agent_explanation: NS green starts ~step 489-490 and is still held at step 686 (~197 s), far beyond max_green_seconds=87, while EW approaches E/W wait at red with large queues (75+ s by step 560, 91/200 at step 685, 91/201 at 686). The N detector_fail active from t=562 covers the period when max-green expiry/recall should have ended NS green (~step 576). The controller therefore fails to enforce max-green / long-wait recall while a detector on the green direction has failed, starving EW past the 200 s max_wait limit. Removing the detector_fail event eliminates the violation.
